integrity: The proof partitions all labelings by the two spine labels, derives necessary-and-sufficient page constraints in each case, uses inclusion-exclusion only for the two global spine-zero requirements, and is independently stress-tested by complete enumeration on the first five books.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the standard square-book family; alternative triangular-book conventions are excluded.
The finite exhaustive verifier covers book sizes from one through five pages and is corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
The known Roman domination number for square books with at least two pages is prior-covered; the new claim is the complete all-weight enumerator and its multiplicity consequences.
A differently named or poorly indexed treatment under product or prism terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Roman domination polynomial of book graphs
